title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - JustInSequencePart
description: A just-in-sequence part is an instantiation of a (design-)part, where the particular instantiation can be uniquely identified by means of a combination of several IDs related to a just-in-sequence process. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.just_in_sequence_part:4.0.0#JustInSequencePart, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'JustInSequencePart'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

partTypeInformation.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.just_in_sequence_part:4.0.0#partTypeInformation'. The part type or part family from which the just-in-sequence part has been instantiated.

nameAtManufacturer.description: Name of the part as assigned by the manufacturer

manufacturerPartId.description: Part ID as assigned by the manufacturer of the part. The Part ID identifies the part (as designed) in the manufacturer`s dataspace. The Part ID does not reference a specific instance of a part and thus should not be confused with the serial number or batch number.

customerPartId.description:
Part ID as assigned by the customer of the part. The customer Part ID identifies the part (as designed)in the customer`s dataspace. The Part ID does not reference a specific instance of a part and thus should not be confused with the serial number or any other instance IDs. 
If no specific part ID exists a part family ID may be substituted for it.

nameAtCustomer.description: Name of the part as assigned by the customer

partClassification.description: Property describing the classification of a part.

items.description: Encapsulates data related to the classification of the part.

id.description: The classification ID of the part type according to the corresponding standard definition mentioned in the key value pair.

description.description: Optional property describing the classification standard.

localIdentifiers.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#localIdentifiers'. A local identifier enables identification of a part in a specific dataspace, but is not unique in the Catena-X dataspace. Multiple local identifiers may exist.

items.description: A list of key value pairs for local identifiers, which are composed of a key and a corresponding value.

key.description: The key of a local identifier.

manufacturingInformation.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.manufacturing_information:1.0.0#manufacturingInformation'. Information from manufacturing process, such as manufacturing date and manufacturing country

productionDate.description: Timestamp of the manufacturing date as the final step in production process (e.g. final quality check, ready-for-shipment event)

country.description: Alphabetic three-character (alpha-3) code representing a country name.

sites.description: A site is a delimited geographical area where a legal entity does business(geographical address with geo coordinates).A site always has a primary physical address. It is possible that further physical addresses are specified for the site. P.O. box details are only possible in addition to the physical address. A site has a 1:n relation to addresses, means at least 1 address is necessary and multiple addresses are possible.

items.description: Describes the ID and function of a site for the associated part in the AsBuilt context(e.g. SerialPart, Batch, jIS).

siteId.description: The identifier of the site according to BPDM. The siteId must be a valid BPN. The BPN is a unique, unchangeable identifier for Business Partners / company locations from foundation to closure, regardless of the different business relationships / structures between or within the Business Partners or company locations.

function.description: The function of the site in relation to the part(i.e. the activity within the value chain of the part that is performed at the site)

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
